messages:
Emma (Marketing): Quick sync — we're locking the launch post schedule. Need Eng to sign off on the changelog link and docs URL before T-24h. @Sam can you confirm merge timing and whether we have a stable docs URL to point to? :eyes:
Sam (Engineering): On it. Changelog PR is up (#842). Waiting on final perf numbers from bench run. If those look good I can merge in ~6h.
Priya (Product): Marketing needs a stable docs path for the announcement (we avoid linking PRs). Can we publish to a releases path like /docs/releases/2026-03-opt?
Sam (Engineering): Agree. I'll hold the changelog until the docs assets are live. Jorge, can you deploy the docs bundle to staging and confirm a canonical URL?
Jorge (DevEx): Kicking off staging deploy now. Running the static build and CDN invalidation.
deploy-bot: deploy started to staging environment — job id: deploy-7782. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/7782
Jorge (DevEx): Command I ran: ```bash
gcloud builds submit --config=cloudbuild-docs.yaml && gcloud run deploy docs-staging --image=gcr.io/redwood/docs:2026-03-opt
```
Jorge (DevEx): Staging deploy finished ✅. Assets are available at https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-opt — can we use that as the canonical link for the announcement?
Emma (Marketing): Nice, thanks Jorge. Priya, will you hold the post until Sam merges? We want the public link to be the stable docs URL not the staging one.
Priya (Product): For the public post we need the final URL. If Sam can merge and we push to prod, we'll swap the staging link for https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-opt. Sam, any blockers for prod push?
Sam (Engineering): No blockers — once PR #842 is merged I’ll trigger the release job. Note on messaging: bench shows ~2× throughput improvement on typical gen workloads vs previous release, and consistent latency under typical SLOs. Recommend we say "~2× throughput improvement" and link the test harness rather than stating a single latency number.
Emma (Marketing): Good guidance. We'll use conservative wording: "~2× throughput improvement on common text-gen workloads (see benchmark notes)" and link the harness. What's the harness URL?
Sam (Engineering): Test harness + raw results are here: https://bench.redwood.internal/reports/release-2026-03 (public version will be sanitized).
Priya (Product): On webinar and lead routing: we plan a launch webinar the week after release. Please route webinar signups into the "launch-bench-webinar" nurture in HubSpot and tag leads with "launch-2026-03". Jorge — can you add the webhook that attaches the tag on registration?
Jorge (DevEx): Yep — I'll add the Zapier/HubSpot webhook. Example curl to attach tag: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact/vid/123/profile -H "Authorization: Bearer $HAPI" -d '{"properties": [{"property": "hs_tags", "value": "launch-2026-03"}]}'
```
Jorge (DevEx): I'll also add a filter so only webinar registrants get the tag.
Emma (Marketing): Checklist for go-time: 1) Merge changelog PR 2) Publish docs to prod and confirm canonical URL 3) Publish launch post + schedule social/webinar 4) Confirm benchmark language and link 5) Ensure HubSpot webhook/tag for inbound leads. Please react :thumbsup: when each item is done.
Sam (Engineering): merged PR #842 — done :white_check_mark: (5409901200)
Jorge (DevEx): prod docs pushed, canonical URL is https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-opt — CDN edge in 10m — done :white_check_mark: (5409902400)
Priya (Product): Webinar scheduled for Apr 6, draft post in Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/launchs/2026-03-draft. I'll finalize wording once Sam confirms public benchmark link sanitizer.
Sam (Engineering): I'll sanitize the bench report for public consumption and post the public results link by EOD.
Emma (Marketing): Amazing — sounds like we're on track. Final ask: when you merge/push, drop the final changelog file to /docs/releases/2026-03-opt/changelog.md and post the public benchmark URL in this thread so we can schedule the announcement. :rocket:
Priya (Product): Will do.
Emma (Marketing): thanks everyone — ping me if anything slips.
